title: “The Argument” podcast, ad free: What do we really know about Elizabeth Holmes?
contentHtml:
In the lull before the midterms, Matt and Jerusalem took a break from political horse races to discuss the recent film “You Can See Everything.” Matt thinks Elizabeth Holmes might come off more sympathetic if she were willing to admit some fault in her actions.
